title: اولین روز در مدرسه جدید
introduction: داستان را آرام بخوان. لازم نیست همه واژه‌ها را از قبل بلد باشی؛ معنی جمله را از متن حدس بزن.
paragraphs: It is Sara’s first day at a new school. She feels a little nervous. She walks into the classroom and looks for an empty seat.
A girl smiles at her. “Hello! Is this seat free?” Sara asks. “Yes, it is. My name is Emma,” the girl says.
“I’m Sara. Nice to meet you,” Sara replies. They talk about their favorite books and soon become friends.
At the end of the day, Sara is happy. The new school does not feel so strange anymore.
